page.layout: Two printed pages on the scan. Left page: one column of running text with Greek and Latin, page number at top left, running head at top centre. Right page (cut off at the fold, partly visible): narrow marginal and column text in small, dense type, mostly unreadable.

main_text.p: ἀ.1.aor.ἐῤῥάβδισα. praef.pass. ῥαβδίζομαι. praet. pass. ἐῤῥαβδίσθην. aor.1.pass. ἐῤῥαβδίσθην ης η. Paulo aliter accipitur Iud.6.11. ἐῤῥαβδίζε pro ἐῤῥαβδίζε. (3.sing.imperf.act.) πυρὸς ἐν λίκῳ decutiebat triticum in quadam areola.

Ῥαβδοῦχος ὁ, ῥάβδον τὸ ἔχων ῥάβδον quòd gestaret bacillum, viator, quo magistratus utebatur vocandi & nuntiandi causâ, non autem ligandi, quod erat lictorum. Quamvis videatur probabile, utrorumque munera fuisse confusa. & lictorem quoque ῥαβδοῦχον fuisse appellatum.

Ῥαδιουργία ας ἡ scelus, maleficentia. ἀ ῥαδιουργὸς ὁ maleficus, qui ad scelus perpetrandum facilè allicitur, cui non est religio turpe quid patrare. ex ῥᾳδίως facilis & ἔργον τὸ opus, der auß der sünd ein handwerck gemacht hat.
Ῥαδιουργημα τὸ veteratorium facinus, ab eo profectum, cujus animus ad omnem nequitiam occalluit. ἀ ῥαδιουργέω ὦ facile ad scelus perpetrandum prorumpo. F.ἡσω. P.ἐῤῥαδιούργηκα.
Ῥακὰ vox convicii Syriaca, Latinè vanus, cerebro vacuus.
Ῥάκος ε& τὸ panniculus ein lumbe item vestis detrita & rejicula. ἀ ῥήσσω ich reiße frango. ῥακώδης εσσα ἐν pannosus a um zerrissen.
Ῥαντίζω aspergo. Fut. ίσω. P. ἐῤῥάντικα. aor.1. ἐῤῥάντισα. prat.pass. ἐῤῥάντισμαι. part.prat.pass. ἐῤῥαντ-
Right-page marginal text is too small and cut off at the fold to transcribe.

page.notes: The right page is largely illegible: its narrow columns and marginal notes are cut off by the fold and too small to read. The Greek is copied as far as the scan allows; accents and some letters are uncertain and may need checking against the original. The last line of the page is a catchword fragment ("ἐῤῥαν-") and is included in the text. Marked readings are doubtful.
